payload.summary: Planned adoption of cocoindex-code as the semantic code-search engine with a vendored Postgres/pgvector backend on the coordinator's ParadeDB, exposed via dual MCP/HTTP coordinator surfaces. Source analysis showed ~95% reuse (storage seam = indexer.py + query.py, ~300 lines); a spike quality gate (D9) precedes all backend work.

decisions.title: Adopt cocoindex-code; do not replicate
decisions.rationale: ~5,900-line package is ~95% storage-agnostic; chunking/daemon/MCP/CLI reused as libraries; rebuilding the AST pipeline is a poor trade

decisions.title: Postgres (ParadeDB) backend instead of stock sqlite-vec
decisions.rationale: Index persists across ephemeral cloud sessions, one shared fleet index, hybrid pg_search BM25 unlocked, no new storage silo

decisions.title: Vendor the 2-file backend patch, attempt upstream PR
decisions.rationale: No storage-backend registry upstream; patch is ~300-400 lines; Apache 2.0 permits either outcome

decisions.title: Per-repo chunk tables (code_chunks__<slug>)
decisions.rationale: Zero query changes, DROP TABLE unload, no cross-repo index contention

decisions.title: Coordinator-side query embedding with registry consistency check
decisions.rationale: Cloud agents lack model access; embedder mismatch must be a hard error, not silent degradation

decisions.title: Expose as read-only tool/endpoint, never MCP resource
decisions.rationale: Resources are not proxied in http_proxy mode (coordination_mcp D6); read/write split keeps indexing out of query paths

next_steps: Gate 2 approval, then /implement-feature add-semantic-code-search starting with wp-spike-eval
